latest_release.name: v0.4.0
latest_release.body:
Game crashed? Read this first - **AMD GPU, black screen at start or `VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`:** add `vk_recorder = 0` under `[performance]` in `totk.ini`. - **`failed (-4)` in the log:** comment in #1032 and attach `logs\totk.log`. - **`failed (-2)` or "out of memory" in the log:** comment in #1031 and attach `logs\totk.log`. - **Mods installed:** try once without them, then comment in #1039. - **Anything else:** open an issue with `logs\totk.log`.
Known issues in 0.4.0 - **Laptop: the installer says preparing the shaders failed, the game does not start, or the FPS dropped sharply (#1086):** 0.4.0 asks for the dedicated GPU, which changes the order of the GPUs on many laptops, so a GPU you picked in the menu before may now be the integrated one. Delete the `gpu_index` or `TOTK_GPU_INDEX` line under `[display]` in `totk.ini`, or set GPU to Auto in the menu (Screen tab), then run the installer again. - **Game 1.2.1 with DLSS: the camera looks zoomed into the top-left corner (#1106):** the screen shows only part of the picture DLSS made. Turn DLSS off in the menu (Graphics) until the fix.
Want more FPS? Try these settings Add them to `totk.ini` next to `totk.exe` under `[performance]`, one at a time: | Setting | Helps when | Cost | | --- | --- | --- | | `sync_ahead = 1`, and on Windows also `shadow = 1` | You are below your FPS limit on a dedicated GPU. The game builds the next frame while the GPU draws the previous one: +31% on an RTX 4070 Ti at 1440p, 73 to 100 FPS on an RX 9070 XT. | One more frame of input delay. On Windows, `shadow = 1` keeps a second copy of the game's memory in RAM: about 4.5 GB more (#1079), so skip it with 16 GB of RAM or less. No gain on integrated graphics. | | `replay_workers = 4` (also in the menu under Advanced, Scheduling) | You play at 1440p or 4K: 71 to 79 FPS in a town at 4K on an RTX 5070. No change at 1080p on a fast CPU. | About 250 MB of VRAM and 300 MB of RAM: leave it at `0` on an 8 GB card or integrated graphics. | Please report your CPU, GPU, resolution and FPS before and after in the comments or an issue, even if it just works: settings that help widely get turned on by default. Flicker, pop-in or a crash? Set it back and attach `logs\totk.log`.
To update, run the new installer on your existing install folder. It keeps your game files, saves and `totk.ini`, and rebuilds `totk.exe` and the shaders. > [!WARNING] > DLSS and the Linux build are tested by the community. I don't have the hardware to test them myself. ### Memory and crashes - **About 1.4 GB less memory over a long session (#921).** On a 10-minute ride through Hyrule Field the game now holds 30% less VRAM (4.8 to 3.4 GB) and 1.4 GB less system memory on an RX 9070. Textures the game no longer uses are kept up to 256 MB instead of up to 800 MB or more, and video memory is taken from the driver in smaller blocks, so less of it sits allocated but empty. The frame rate and stutter did not change. - **A short out-of-memory spell no longer ends the game (#1031, #1028, #1010, #553, #348, #362, #1027).** When Windows can't give memory at that moment, the game frees what it can spare and retries for up to 30 seconds instead of closing with a fatal error. Crash logs with "out of memory" at a full system, failed staging buffers or failed image creation should mostly go away. - **System memory is counted where video memory takes it (#285, #670).** Some drivers, AMD's among them, charge every byte of video memory to the game's system memory too. The game measures this at start and now keeps the total under what the system can give, instead of watching the video memory budget alone. Integrated graphics (AMD APUs, Intel), where video memory is system memory, benefit the most. - **Integrated graphics use compressed textures by default.** Switch textures are now converted to BC3 instead of uncompre
